name: Horse The
overview: Scripture portrays horses as significant instruments of power and honor, often associated with kings and their authority, as seen when the king's horse is used to publicly honor Mordecai, highlighting the horse's role in royal ceremonies (Esther 6:8-10). Horses also serve practical purposes in conveying messages swiftly, demonstrated by the horseback messengers sent to inquire about peace during Jehu's approach (2 Kings 9:17-19). These verses emphasize the horse's dual role in both the majesty of leadership and the urgency of communication.
